name: openbb_cash_flow
description:
Cash flow statements (operating, investing, financing, free cash flow) for one company through the OpenBB Platform (obb.equity.fundamental.cash).
Returns: {symbol, provider, data_points, truncated, statements: [one record per period with period_ending, fiscal period and the line items]} or {symbol, error}.
Inputs (* required): symbol*; period (annual or quarter; default annual); limit (periods, 1-100; default 5); provider (fmp, intrinio, polygon, sec, yfinance; default yfinance).
Related: openbb_income_statement, openbb_balance_sheet; other sources: yf_cash_flow, av_cash_flow. Keys: sec, yfinance need none; fmp uses SAJHA's FMP_API_KEY; intrinio, polygon need a key in ~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL", "period": "quarter", "limit": 4}
